title: Data Diversity, Not Frequency Invariance: A Controlled and Self-Audited Study of Compression-Robust Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.28685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frequency features and compression-invariant representation learning are widely assumed to be key to deepfake detection that survives video compression. We test this with CAFRL - block-DCT and FFT-phase streams, compression-level-conditioned band attention, and adversarial (gradient-reversal) compression invariance - and report a controlled negative. Under a pre-registered protocol with capacity- and augmentation-matched controls, a plain EfficientNet-B0 on multi-quality data beat CAFRL as specified at every compression level on the FaceForensics++ test split, by 3.66 AUC points at CRF 40 (paired, single seed). A self-audit of our own negative found four defects biased against the frequency hypothesis, and pre-specified re-tests repairing all four showed the deficit to be a recipe artifact, not an architecture failure: the baseline recipe recovered 3.96 points over the matching shipped-recipe variant. translated_title: 数据多样性，而非频率不变性：一项关于压缩鲁棒深度伪造检测的受控与自审计研究
translated_abstract: 频率特征与压缩不变表征学习被广泛认为是使深度伪造检测在视频压缩下依然有效的关键。我们通过CAFRL对此进行检验——该模型包含块DCT与FFT相位流、以压缩级别为条件的频带注意力，以及对抗性（梯度反转）压缩不变性——并报告了一项受控的阴性结果。在预注册协议以及容量与数据增强均匹配的对照条件下，一个在多质量数据上训练的普通EfficientNet-B0在FaceForensics++测试集的所有压缩级别上都优于按规范配置的CAFRL，在CRF 40下领先3.66个AUC点（配对比较，单随机种子）。对我们自身阴性结果的自审计发现了四个不利于频率假设的缺陷，而修复全部四个缺陷的预先指定复测表明，这一差距源于训练配方的人为因素，而非架构缺陷：基线配方比对应的发布配方变体恢复了3.96个点。频率路径未产生可检测的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过受控实验与自审计发现，深度伪造检测的压缩鲁棒性关键在于训练数据的多样性而非频率特征或压缩不变架构——在多质量数据上训练的普通EfficientNet-B0在所有压缩级别上都超越了专门的频率模型CAFRL。
en_tdlr: Controlled, self-audited experiments show that compression-robust deepfake detection hinges on data diversity rather than frequency invariance: a plain EfficientNet-B0 trained on multi-quality data outperforms the frequency-based CAFRL model at every compression level.
